headline: Bogdan Ivan calls for controls on fuel prices. 'Why are they paying so much and who checks whether these prices are correct'
summary: Bogdan Ivan has highlighted the effects of rising fuel prices on the population and economy and has requested price checks from authorities. He questions who verifies the prices.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport and logistics costs, inflation and household spending across the economy.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Bogdan Ivan cere controale la prețurile carburanților. „De ce plătesc atât de mult și cine verifică dacă aceste prețuri sunt corecte”
